dialogues.jp: 「ふぐぅぅ……」

腕を伸ばし、枕元に貼りつけた目覚まし時計の
スイッチを切る。今こいつに自由に動かれたら、
電池が切れるまで音を止めることはできまい。
dialogues.en:
I stretched out my arm and turned the alarm off. I have it
close by my side because if it moves, I won't be able to
stop it until the battery runs out.
dialogues.text:
I stretched out my arm and turned the alarm off. I have it
close by my side because if it moves, I won't be able to
stop it until the battery runs out.

dialogues.jp:
身体を起こすと、少し足を｛かば／庇｝う感じでベッドか
ら降りる。
dialogues.en: I woke up and got out of bed, protecting my leg.
dialogues.text: I woke up and got out of bed, protecting my leg.

dialogues.jp: 今日から本校での新しい学園生活が始まる。
dialogues.en:
Today was the day my new school life was going to start at
the main school.
dialogues.text:
Today was the day my new school life was going to start at
the main school.

dialogues.jp:
松葉杖では登校するのに時間がかかるので、今
まで音夢が起きていた時間にセットしていた。
dialogues.en:
I'd set the alarm to the time Nemu usually wakes up, because
it'll take me a while to get ready for school with crutches.
dialogues.text:
I'd set the alarm to the time Nemu usually wakes up, because
it'll take me a while to get ready for school with crutches.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、二度寝しないで起きれたのには自分
でも意外だったが……。
dialogues.en:
I was proud of myself for not falling back asleep
again......
dialogues.text:
I was proud of myself for not falling back asleep
again......

dialogues.jp: （今日は萌先輩が迎えに来るんだったな）
dialogues.en: (Moe-sempai's supposed to be picking me up today.)
dialogues.text: (Moe-sempai's supposed to be picking me up today.)

dialogues.jp:
いつもの倍の時間をかけて制服に着替えると、
朝食を食べに居間に向かう。
dialogues.en:
It took me twice as long to get dressed as usual, and then I
went to the living room to get some breakfast.
dialogues.text:
It took me twice as long to get dressed as usual, and then I
went to the living room to get some breakfast.

dialogues.jp: 「そろそろ１時限目の授業が始まってる頃かな」
dialogues.en: "It's about time for the first period to start."
dialogues.text: "It's about time for the first period to start."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩のことだから、多少遅れてくることは予
想していたけど、ここまでとは……。
dialogues.en:
I expected her to be late, but I never thought she would be
this late......
dialogues.text:
I expected her to be late, but I never thought she would be
this late......

dialogues.jp:
「ま、初日の授業なんてオリエンテーションみ
　たいなもんだし、別にいいだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Well, the first day of class is usually just an
orientation. I won't miss anything."
dialogues.text:
"Well, the first day of class is usually just an
orientation. I won't miss anything."

dialogues.jp:
ソファーに座り、秘境を探検する気分で、この
時間にどんな番組がやっているのかを確認する。
dialogues.en:
I sat on the couch to check out what kind of TV shows
they're showing around this time.
dialogues.text:
I sat on the couch to check out what kind of TV shows
they're showing around this time.

dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……こんなにのんびりとテレビを観たの
　も久しぶりだなぁ」

いま、ブラウン管には『怒っていいとも！』が
映っている。
dialogues.en:
"Hmm...... It's been a while since I watched TV and relaxed
like this."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm...... It's been a while since I watched TV and relaxed
like this."

dialogues.jp: リアルで観るのなんて何ヶ月ぶりだろう……。
dialogues.en: "Price's wrong." was on the TV.
dialogues.text: "Price's wrong." was on the TV.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、どこまで観ていられるかな……」
dialogues.en: I haven't seen this show for months......
dialogues.text: I haven't seen this show for months......

dialogues.jp:
もう、ここまで来るとある意味、吹っ切れる。
この際、夜中に来たってＯＫだ。
dialogues.en: "I wonder how long I can watch this show......"
dialogues.text: "I wonder how long I can watch this show......"

dialogues.en:
I'm late enough now so I'm willing to wait for her until
midnight.
dialogues.text:
I'm late enough now so I'm willing to wait for her until
midnight.

dialogues.jp:
ブラウン管の中では、ちょうど今日のゲストが
姿を現したところだった……。
――ピンポーン
dialogues.en:
They were calling out the first group of contestants on the
show......
dialogues.text:
They were calling out the first group of contestants on the
show......

dialogues.jp: 「おっ、来たかな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, she might be here!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, she might be here!"

dialogues.jp: テレビ電源をプツンと切って、玄関に向かう。
dialogues.en: I cut off the TV and went toward the front door.
dialogues.text: I cut off the TV and went toward the front door.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……とても遅れてしまいまし
　た……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry...... I'm so late......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry...... I'm so late......"

dialogues.jp:
扉を開けると、しゅん――といった感じの萌先
輩が、目の前に立っていた。
dialogues.en:
When I opened the door, Moe-sempai was standing with a sad
face.
dialogues.text:
When I opened the door, Moe-sempai was standing with a sad
face.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ……いいですよ。それより、せっかくだ
　から行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "It's okay...... Shall we go now?"
dialogues.text: "It's okay...... Shall we go now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 先輩に鞄を渡し、松葉杖をついて家の外に出る。
dialogues.en: I gave my bag to Moe-sempai and left home with my crutches.
dialogues.text: I gave my bag to Moe-sempai and left home with my crutches.

dialogues.jp: ｛・・／西日｝の射す、いい天気だった……。
dialogues.en: The light from the western sun was feeling comfortable......
dialogues.text: The light from the western sun was feeling comfortable......

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩のお迎え◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe-sempai's escort◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe-sempai's escort◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩を待ち続けた。
dialogues.en: I waited for Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I waited for Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: が、なかなか来てくれなかった。
dialogues.en: However she didn't show up for a long time.
dialogues.text: However she didn't show up for a long time.

dialogues.jp:
来てくれた時には、外には、西日が射していた
……。
dialogues.en:
When she finally came, the sunlight was shining from the
west......
dialogues.text:
When she finally came, the sunlight was shining from the
west......
